get.description: Returns matching events, newest first by event time.

parameters.description: Comma-separated sources. Defaults to every source the token can read.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page, at most 1024 bytes. Send it with the same index, range, filters and limit; anything else returns `400`.

parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON, at most 4096 bytes decoded. Exact, typed matches on top-level attributes; every condition must match, along with the other filters. get.description: Requires a read token with no source or index restriction. Scoped tokens get `403`.

text/plain.example:
# HELP logbrook_ingested_events_total Durably committed events
# TYPE logbrook_ingested_events_total counter
logbrook_ingested_events_total 10
# HELP logbrook_ingest_rejected_total Rejected ingest requests
# TYPE logbrook_ingest_rejected_total counter
logbrook_ingest_rejected_total 3
# HELP logbrook_ready Storage readiness
# TYPE logbrook_ready gauge
logbrook_ready 1
# HELP logbrook_http_duration_seconds Handler latency by endpoint
# TYPE logbrook_http_duration_seconds histogram
logbrook_http_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/health",le="0.001"} 1
logbrook_http_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/health",le="0.01"} 1
logbrook_http_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/health",le="0.1"} 1
logbrook_http_duration_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/health",le="0.5"} 1

logbrook_http_duration_seconds_sum{endpoint="/health"} 0.000037
logbrook_http_duration_seconds_count{endpoint="/health"} 1

get.description:
Streams events as Server-Sent Events, in ingestion order. Without `Last-Event-ID` the stream starts after the newest committed event; with it, retained events after that ID are replayed first.

`log` frames carry one event. A `cursor` frame means the stream has caught up. `gap` and `error` frames end the stream; after a `gap`, search the retained history before you reconnect.

Frame IDs are opaque resume tokens bound to the route and filters. They aren't interchangeable with `next_cursor` values or event `id`s.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: ID of the last frame you processed, at most 1024 bytes. Send it on the same route with the same filters; anything else returns `400`. An event's JSON `id` is not a resume ID.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON, at most 4096 bytes decoded. Exact, typed matches on top-level attributes; every condition must match, along with the other filters. Missing and null values never match. Duplicate or unknown members and conflicting conditions return `400`. The request path and query together are limited to 32768 bytes.

200.description: SSE log, cursor, gap, error frames

get.description: Lists the indexes the token can read. An admin token sees every index. Source-scoped read tokens get names only; other callers also get file sizes and retention policy.

put.description: Creates the index with the configured policy, or returns it if it already exists. Requires an admin token, or an ingestion token scoped to the index. `max_indexes` caps how many can exist.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index name: lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. The token's index scope applies as well as its source scope.

get.description: Source-scoped read tokens get the name only; other callers also get file sizes and retention policy.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index name: lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. The token's index scope applies as well as its source scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a dynamically created index and its events. Requires the admin token. The `default` index and indexes declared in the server configuration can't be deleted. Once accepted, the deletion finishes even if the client disconnects. A later ingest to the same name recreates the index, so stop producers first.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index name: lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. The token's index scope applies as well as its source scope.

400.description: Invalid name or protected default/configured index

503.description: Shutdown or filesystem operation failed; inspect state before retrying

bearerAuth.description: Configured tokens contain 16 to 512 visible ASCII characters without whitespace.

IndexInfo.description: `name` is always present. The other fields are omitted for source-scoped read tokens. Sizes are logical file lengths measured at request time, not allocated disk blocks.

key.description: Top-level attribute key, 1–256 bytes and within the configured field limit. Nested paths aren't supported.

value.description: Value to match exactly. Strings up to 1024 bytes, numbers up to 128 bytes as written. Null, objects and arrays are rejected. Integers compare exactly across the i64 and u64 ranges; decimals compare as 64-bit floats.
